sections.h2: The basket now gives sweet Brent 61% of its weight, up from 21%

chart.title: The sweet benchmark's weight jumped from 21% to 61% in March 2026
chart.sub: Dated Brent's share of the Indian Basket price formula, %.
chart.source: PPAC formula as reported by Business Standard (April 2026).

sections.means: The basket is a price formula, so a heavier Brent weight means India's crude is priced like sweet crude, not that more of it is sweet.
sections.todo: Read the basket price next to the grades actually loaded before treating its ratio as a sulphur mix.

sections.h2: Russian crude into India fell from 2,820 to 1,820 thousand barrels a day

chart.title: Russian crude into India fell from July to September as Gulf flows recovered
chart.sub: Crude into India from Russia, thousand barrels a day.
chart.source: Kpler via Business Standard and Hellenic Shipping News. Monthly tanker-tracking estimates, not customs data.

sections.means: Russian intake followed the discount, which had mostly disappeared by March as Urals sold above Dated Brent.
sections.todo: Track monthly tanker-tracking estimates against the sour grades refiners process before judging the sweet-sour mix.

sections.h2: US crude arriving in India fell 87% between October 2025 and August 2026

chart.title: US crude into India fell from 565 to 75 thousand barrels a day
chart.sub: Crude into India from the US, thousand barrels a day.
chart.source: Kpler via Indian Oil & Gas (August 2026). Monthly tanker-tracking estimates, not customs data.

sections.means: US crude, the sweetest grade in the mix, was cheap in October 2025 when the Brent–WTI spread was wide, and had shrunk to a fraction by August.
